description: Change a quote. Required: offer_id. Optional: lines (replaces all of them; unit_price in MAIN units — 100 = 100,00 € — or unit_price_minor in cents; a line without vat_rate gets the recipient's default), title, recipient, address, intro, outro, valid_until, status, country, language, tax_note, currency. Totals are always recomputed from the lines — a total that disagrees with its own lines is never stored. A quote that has been sent refuses line changes unless force=true, because the customer is holding the old figures. The answer gives every amount in main units, *_minor in cents, and printed in the recipient's format.

force.description: true allows line changes on a quote that was already sent

intro.description: Introductory text printed above the positions

lines.description: New positions; replaces all existing lines of the quote

items.description: unit_price in MAIN units (100 = 100,00), or unit_price_minor in cents.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to change

outro.description: Closing text printed below the positions

tax_note.description: Tax note printed on the quote (e.g. reverse charge text)

valid_until.description: Date until which the quote is valid (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: update_offer
